name: MonarchLinkCard
title: LinkCard
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.Surface (through MonarchCard), androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalUriHandler, androidx.compose.foundation.Image (through Monarch's internal MonarchImage), MonarchFavicon
summary: A preview of a shared link from data the app unfurled: picture, site, title and description in one tappable card, with an optional remove button.
whenToUse: Under a message, comment or post that contains a link the app has unfurled.
whenNotToUse: For a link inside running text use a text link. For a file use a file card. Do not fetch the page from the device just to show a card; unfurl on the server.
api: @Composable fun MonarchLinkCard(title: String, url: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, siteName: String? = null, image: Painter? = null, hasImage: Boolean = image != null, imageAspectRatio: Float? = null, favicon: Painter? = null, video: Boolean = false, size: MonarchLinkCardSize = MonarchLinkCardSize.Md, onOpen: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null, dismissIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, dismissLabel: String? = null, removeLabel: String? = null, videoLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The page title, up to two lines.

options.name: url
options.description: The link. Only http, https and mailto open; anything else shows the card as plain text.

options.name: description
options.description: The page description, up to two lines.

options.name: siteName
options.description: The site above the title; the host without "www." by default.

options.name: image
options.description: The page's picture, loaded by the app.

options.name: hasImage
options.description: Whether the page has a picture; pass true while it loads so a muted tile keeps its place.

options.name: imageAspectRatio
options.description: The picture's width over height; kept between 1.2 and 2.2, and 2.2 when unknown.

options.name: favicon
options.description: The site's icon; without it MonarchFavicon draws a letter tile.

options.name: video
options.description: Shows a "Video" badge on the picture (or by the site without a picture), also read by TalkBack.

options.name: size
options.description: Md: the picture above the text. Sm: a 64dp thumbnail beside it.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Called with the url instead of opening it with LocalUriHandler.

options.name: dismissIcon
options.description: The remove button's icon; the button then sits in the top end corner. Without it the button is a small "Remove" button under the card.

options.name: dismissLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name "Remove the preview of" and the title (monarch_linkcard_dismiss).

options.name: removeLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in text "Remove" of the button without an icon (monarch_linkcard_remove).

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press, focus and hover interactions of the card.

states.name: picture loading
states.description: With hasImage and no painter, a muted tile keeps the picture's place; it stays if loading fails.

states.name: not a safe link
states.description: The card is shown as plain text, read as one element, and does not open.

states.name: dismissible
states.description: A remove button, an icon button with a surface-coloured circle in the top end corner or a small text button under the card.

appearance: A MonarchCard (surface color, default border, 12dp corners) without padding; the picture fills its top or a thumbnail at the end. Site in the muted caption style, title in the strong body style, description in the muted caption style. The picture's placeholder uses the muted background. The video badge is a solid neutral MonarchBadge. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web LinkCard renders an anchor that opens a new tab with rel attributes, has a footer slot and comes with LinkCardList and LinkCardSkeleton. On Android the card opens the link through LocalUriHandler, which the app can replace (for example with Custom Tabs), or through onOpen; there is no footer (place product actions under the card), a list is a Column of cards, and there is no skeleton type (use MonarchSkeleton). Following the Monarch picture convention, the picture and favicon are Painters the app loads; there is no URL loading, unlike the iOS imageURL initialiser. The web draws a play mark on a video's picture; Monarch draws no glyphs, so a "Video" badge says it in text. The remove button needs an icon the app supplies; without one it is a text button under the card, so it never sits over the text. The picture ratio rule (1.2 to 2.2, 2.2 when unknown) matches iOS. Compose has no link role, so the card is read as a button.
accessibility: A safe link is one element with the Button role, read as the site, the title, the description and "Video" for a video; the picture and favicon are hidden.
A link that does not open is one plain element with the same text.
The remove button is a separate element named "Remove the preview of" and the title, with a touch target of at least 48dp, at the end in both layout directions.
The title is not cut at font scale 2.0 when it fits in two lines; longer titles and descriptions end with an ellipsis.
edgeCases: Long titles and descriptions are limited to two lines.
Very tall or very wide pictures are cropped to the 1.2 to 2.2 ratio range.
Without a site name and with a URL that has no host (mailto), the site line is left out.
With an icon remove button and no banner, the text keeps 48dp free at the end so the button never covers it.
Opening the link on a device was not tried; tests check the call to LocalUriHandler.

examples.title: Link preview
examples.template:
MonarchLinkCard(
    title = {{title}},
    url = {{url}},
    description = {{description}},
    siteName = {{siteName}},
    image = samplePlaceholderPainter(),
    imageAspectRatio = {{image.width|raw}}f / {{image.height|raw}}f,
)
examples.code:
MonarchLinkCard(
    title = "Your first week: a practical guide",
    url = "https://example.com/guides/first-week",
    description = "What to set up, who to meet and where to find things in your first five days.",
    siteName = "Example Guides",
    image = samplePlaceholderPainter(),
    imageAspectRatio = 1200f / 630f,
)

examples.title: A small, removable video link
examples.code:
if (shown) {
    MonarchLinkCard(
        title = "Product tour",
        url = "https://example.com/tour",
        image = samplePainter(),
        video = true,
        size = MonarchLinkCardSize.Sm,
        onDismiss = { shown = false },
        dismissIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
    )
}
